title: Malaysia & Singapore, from the Malay and Chinese press

stories.text: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong will visit Qatar and the UAE from 18 to 22 October, his first such trip since becoming prime minister.
The Bersama party has suspended Nik Nazmi from all official activities for three months after his khalwat (close proximity) arrest.
PKR Negeri Sembilan urged the Menteri Besar to explain a letter he sent to the Keeper of the Rulers' Seal.
Melaka state election: PAS president Hadi Awang says the party's candidate list is complete.
The Sarawak state election may be held this December, according to Abdul Karim.
The Agong said freedom comes with responsibility and urged Malaysians to use social media with good manners.
25 areas in Malaysia recorded unhealthy air pollution readings, with Pasir Gudang the worst at close to 200.
Demand for masks in Singapore has jumped fivefold amid the haze, and pharmacy chains have started limiting purchases.
Malaysia's tax collection last year passed RM200 billion, a record high, with an official crediting the media for raising tax awareness.
Kuala Lumpur Immigration is investigating a senior officer accused of abusing power to approve passes that allegedly helped online scam members stay in Malaysia.
stories.source: Sin Chew Daily 星洲日报

stories.text: After 10 complaints of RON95 petrol mixed with water, the Domestic Trade Ministry is investigating seven petrol stations in Selangor.
The Carey Island development is expected to generate RM4.7 billion in GDP and 115,000 jobs.
Drugs are behind 75 percent of inmates held in 41 prisons in Malaysia.
About 370,000 Singapore CPF members voluntarily topped up their retirement savings by S$6 billion in the first three quarters of this year.
Casino advertising and promotions in Singapore will need prior approval, and phrases like "easy to win" or "don't miss out" may breach the rules.
